ValidationRule.description: This validation rule triggers if user changes the record type as IME SC Case Resolved and status not equal to closed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT(ISCHANGED( IME_SC_Owner_Manager__c )), NOT(ISCHANGED( IME_SC_Manager_of_Manager_OwnerId__c )), $RecordType.Name = "IME SC Case Resolved" , NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status ,"Closed")) )
